spanish: Y tomarás sólet, y la hornearás doce tortas; dos décimos será la torta la una.

findings.issue: סֹלֶת is a common noun left as the untranslated Hebrew loan sólet; common nouns stay Spanish.

notes: The other tokens match person, number, the 3fs object, twelve cakes, two tenths, and the definite cake the one.
